subject.title: [Bug]: qqbot + ollama + local model: qwen3.5:27b report: error Embedded agent failed before reply: LLM request failed: network connection was interrupted

question: For QQBot/local-provider runs that hit `terminated | read ECONNRESET` before a long configured provider timeout, should OpenClaw wait/recover differently or surface the provider reset as a failure?
rationale: Source shows the old QQBot cap is fixed and raw reset errors are classified, but deciding whether to extend recovery for silent provider resets can trade off long blocked sessions against local-model reliability.

options.title: Require Live Repro First
options.body: Keep this issue open until a current-main QQBot/Ollama run with OpenClaw logs and Ollama/server logs proves which layer aborts before changing recovery behavior.

options.title: Honor Long Timeout More Aggressively
options.body: Change QQBot or diagnostics recovery so silent local-provider resets/stalls wait closer to the configured provider timeout, accepting longer stuck-session risk.

options.title: Treat As Provider Reset
options.body: Document this as an Ollama/server/network failure unless new evidence shows OpenClaw aborting the request before the provider timeout.

recommendation.title: Require Live Repro First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a current-main QQBot/Ollama run with OpenClaw logs and Ollama/server logs proves which layer aborts before changing recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the shipped QQBot watchdog replacement and follow-up test path, making them the best available routing candidate for the remaining QQBot timeout policy choice.
